author: Codex (delegated), under PI directive 2026-08-24 and dated decisions 2026-08-25
purpose: Preregister the Kitagawa/Oaxaca-style decomposition of ReT differences into an intra-regimen (within-branch) component and a composition (branch-mix) component, before any number is computed.

estimand.definition: For two arms a,b scored on the same tapes: Delta = mean(ReT_a) - mean(ReT_b). With per-order branch means m[a,k], m[b,k] over the K=4 snapshot_v2 case branches (excel_fill_rate, excel_autotomy, excel_recovery, excel_risk_no_recovery) and branch shares w[a,k], w[b,k] (shares of that arm's visible rows):
estimand.kitagawa_identity: Delta = sum_k (w_a_k - w_b_k)*m_b_k  [composition C_x]  +  sum_k w_a_k*(m_a_k - m_b_k)  [intra-regimen E]
estimand.oaxaca_mirror: Delta = sum_k w_b_k*(m_a_k - m_b_k) + sum_k (w_a_k - w_b_k)*m_a_k
estimand.twofold_average: the reported primary split uses the equally weighted average of both mirror forms for each component; the two exact mirror decompositions are also recorded in the JSON

tapes_analyzed: all 256 virgin confirmation tapes 7490001-7490256 per cell (Program Q shards); no tape added or dropped

arms_compared.b: best open-loop calendar by mean ReT on these same 256 tapes (reselected inside every bootstrap resample)
per-tape best classical configuration of the frozen ten (reselected inside every bootstrap resample)

falsifiers_declared_before_running: F1: if any learner/open-loop/classical per-order ledger cannot be recovered from the stored shards (no per-row trace in the npz), the corresponding pair is reported NOT_COMPUTABLE rather than approximated from aggregates.
F2: if any recomputed arm mean differs from the shard scalar panels by more than 1e-9, the discrepancy is reported and the analysis stops for that cell.
F3: if composition shares are identical across arms in a cell, the composition component must be exactly zero; a nonzero value would indicate an implementation error.

inference.bootstrap: two-way resampling over learner seeds and tapes, 10,000 resamples, studentized max-t across the six estimands (3 cells x 2 pairs), comparator reselection inside every resample
inference.claim_limit: descriptive/mechanistic decomposition for the manuscript; it adjudicates nothing and changes no verdict
